text:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert: PD#88741 fired for service=redwood-runtime, symptom=gpu_alloc_failure, severity=high. auto-tags: gpu-pool=prod-gpu-3 region=us-west-2

pagerduty: Incident PD-88741 created and assigned to @matt_oncall (level 1). Click to acknowledge: https://pd.example/PD-88741 :rotating_light:

matt: acked PD-88741 — will take first look. any customer reports?

shreya: seeing a spike in OOMs on pool prod-gpu-3. logs show repeated "CUDART_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY" in worker-8654. request rate unchanged.

kevin: copying relevant lines from runtime logs: 
```
2026-02-18T03:12:44Z worker-8654 ERROR cuda: failed to allocate 1.2GiB: out of memory
2026-02-18T03:12:45Z worker-8654 WARN eviction: evicting KV cache prefix for session xyz
2026-02-18T03:12:45Z worker-8654 ERROR runtime: process killed by OOM
```

elaine: nvtop / nvidia-smi snapshot from host node-3: GPU0 99% mem, GPU1 98% mem, few processes pinned to single GPU. PIDs: 21577 (python inference), 21580 (python inference).

matt: thanks. @shreya please check if this is a single runaway job or multiple jobs. also confirm if autoscaler tried to spin up extra nodes.

shreya: quick check: autoscaler did not trigger — cluster reports 0 pending nodes. worker-8654 shows very long sequence of repeated generation requests from client app-id=js-frontend-prod. Possible KV cache blowup + long sequences.

kevin: hypothesis: a cache/kv leak combined with very long context lengths causes per-request mem to balloon. I can try evicting KV cache for the session.

matt: ok try targeted eviction and restart of the worker process. aim to avoid full node drain for now. if it recurs, we should cordon+drain node.

kevin: running commands:
```
kubectl -n runtime exec worker-8654 -- bash -lc 'curl -sS localhost:8080/debug/kvcache/evict?session=xyz'
kubectl -n runtime delete pod worker-8654 --grace-period=30
```

oncall-bot: action logged by matt_oncall — evict request issued, pod restart requested.

matt: restarted worker-8654. monitoring memory.

elaine: post-restart nvml shows GPU0 freed, GPU utilization decaying. no further OOMs on that host for now.

dana: fyi routing layer auto-fallback kicked in for 2 minutes: some requests routed to rwd-llama-7b-quant (lower mem) while pool-gpu-3 recovering. logs show ~240 requests failed with 503s during failover window.

shreya: checking customer impact: telemetry indicates 12 customers saw elevated latency, 3 customers had transient 503s for short windows. affected endpoints mainly chat-stream and long-context batch jobs.

matt: marking incident as mitigated for now. next: create a follow-up ticket to instrument KV cache accounting, add hard per-session mem limits, and tune autoscaler thresholds.

kevin: opened ticket INF-2026: "Investigate KV cache growth + per-session limits" with proposed steps and reproducer notes. assigned to eng-runtime.

matt: escalation check — should we notify SRE lead and customers on status page? I think postmortem + status update appropriate. @elaine prepare a concise status update.

elaine: drafting status update: "We've mitigated a GPU memory pressure event on prod-gpu-3 caused by runaway per-session memory growth; small number of customers experienced transient 503s/latency spikes; worker restarted and routing fallback prevented larger outage. Follow-up: per-session limits & autoscaler tuning." will post in ~15m. :pencil2:

oncall-bot: PD-88741 acknowledged by matt_oncall at 2026-02-18T03:13:09Z; status updated to investigating.

pagerduty: PD-88741 resolved by matt_oncall at 2026-02-18T03:22:30Z — reason: worker restart + KV eviction mitigated pressure.

matt: closing thread here. next steps assigned in INF-2026. will follow up with postmortem once we have root cause. thanks all. :thumbsup:
